notes: Hand-curated synthetic fixture for the full-stack engineer + bootstrapped founder archetype. One ExpectedUnit per fact-bearing bullet across the EXPERIENCE + SIDE PROJECTS sections.

expected_units.normalized_summary: Built Threadline MVP solo over fourteen months — Next.js, Node.js, Postgres, Stripe Billing, Twilio factory-comms; closed first ten customers from cold outbound and Hacker News, hit $10K MRR in seven months

Designed Threadline production-tracking schema and API — single Postgres database with row-level security multi-tenancy, Drizzle ORM, typed REST API; held through three pricing-model changes and 40x customer growth
Led Threadline B2B pivot from D2C-brand-as-customer to factory-as-customer, ran 38 customer development calls in six weeks; ARR per logo doubled, monthly churn dropped from 4.1% to 1.8%
Built Threadline white-labeled customer portal — order status and approvals app sent to brand clients; ~40% of new logos arrive via portal links, custom self-hosted PostHog event tracking
Owned hiring for first eight Threadline engineers — paired-programming and system-design interview loop, onboarding doc, on-call rotation; 100% engineering retention over three years
Drove Threadline Series Seed conversation in late 2024 and chose to stay bootstrapped; wrote customer-facing decision memo, subsequent annual revenue per employee landed at $580K

Led Threadline SOC 2 Type II program single-engineer-plus-vCISO using Drata, cleared auditor first walkthrough with zero exceptions, delivered report three weeks ahead of largest customer procurement deadline

Designed Threadline factory-comms scheduler — Postgres-backed job system with idempotent retries, per-factory dead-letter queues, and SLA-violation alert path replacing Sidekiq plus separate alerting stack
Owned migration of Pliant Rails monolith to TypeScript-Node services for workflow execution path, six-week dual-write window; cut median workflow execution latency from 1.2s to 280ms
Led Pliant multi-tenant data export end-to-end — schema design, Postgres COPY pipeline, S3 hand-off, signed URLs, customer UI; shipped on procurement deadline and unblocked $1.4M ACV deal
Built Pliant async job system on Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY plus row-level locking, replacing Sidekiq for workflow execution; reduced per-job p99 latency by 60% and removed Redis as tier-1 dependency
Co-designed Pliant self-hosted feature-flag system with schema-versioned, audit-logged flag changes and typed Node SDK; adopted by every product team within six months

Took on-call lead role for Pliant platform team for eight months, drove runbook coverage from 31% to 94%, ran weekly incident review, shepherded team through two SEV-2s with zero customer-visible regressions
Shipped Anvil v1 dashboard end-to-end — React front end, Node API, CLI integration backing live-query view; product launched at PostgresConf 2017
Built Anvil query-plan visualizer — React component rendering Postgres EXPLAIN ANALYZE as interactive plan tree with row-estimate-vs-actual deltas; most-trafficked page on marketing site
Migrated Cardinal Logistics freight-pricing calculator from 4,000-line spreadsheet to tested Python/Django service in six months; saved operations team estimated 12 hours per week of reconciliation
Built Reading Years — small personal reading log with public year-end pages, used by 60 people, source open on GitHub
